title: Integrative multi-omics analysis identifies methylation-associated lncRNAs FAM83A-AS2 and AC012213.1 as candidate prognostic markers in lung adenocarcinoma

evidence_spans.quote: Results By integrating RNA-seq and Illumina 450K methylation data from 473 LUAD and 32 normal lung samples
candidate prognostic markers in lung adenocarcinoma

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is a current empirical analysis of human lung-cancer data. Age is used only as a model adjustment, with no aging-process analysis; multi-omics is therefore not assessed.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Promoter methylation associated with lncRNA expression
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Spearman methylation–expression correlations and Cox-model prognostic associations

evidence_spans.quote: Results By integrating RNA-seq and Illumina 450K methylation data from 473 LUAD and 32 normal lung samples in TCGA, we identified
Spearman correlation analysis highlighted seven lncRNAs with inverse promoter methylation–expression patterns
A two-lncRNA prognostic score derived using LASSO Cox regression showed moderate time-dependent discrimination

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The abstract reports completed empirical multi-omics and survival analyses, but the stated analyses are correlation, Cox regression, prognostic scoring, and an exploratory network rather than a qualifying applied design.
